name: model-router-omp
description: Routes Oh My Pi subagents to the smol, midl or slow model role and a thinking level that fits the task, judged by Jev. It scores a task even when you set no model, and sets the effort unless you set one. It sends the task text, condensed to at most 12,000 characters, and the agent's description, cut to 500 characters, with token-shaped strings such as keys masked, to api.typesafe.ai, openrouter.ai or both, as its provider setting allows. The bundled task agent sends a fixed text in place of its description. The scope setting picks the agents: core routes the bundled task agent, extended routes every agent whose model you did not set. A project can set scope, and extended there can raise spend on the midl and slow roles. The plugin can store a key you type in its dialog. A key set as an environment variable is visible to every process omp starts.

provider.description: Which providers judge each task, in order. auto: TypeSafe, then OpenRouter. openrouter-first: OpenRouter, then TypeSafe.

scope.description: Which subagents are routed. core: the task agent only. extended: every agent whose model you did not set, bundled agents included.
